topic: Materiality in planning and performing an audit
question: Discuss the concept of materiality under SA 320, including performance materiality and the circumstances in which the auditor revises materiality during the audit.
sources: SA 320 Materiality in Planning and Performing an Audit

points.label: Meaning of materiality
points.description: Misstatements, including omissions, are material if, alone or together, they could reasonably be expected to influence the economic decisions users take on the basis of the financial statements; the judgment depends on the size and nature of the item and the surrounding circumstances.
points.basis: SA 320, materiality in the context of an audit

points.label: Materiality for the financial statements as a whole
points.description: Set when establishing the overall audit strategy, usually by applying a percentage to a suitable benchmark such as profit before tax, revenue, total expenses or net assets, chosen according to the entity and what users focus on.
points.basis: SA 320, determining materiality when planning the audit (use of benchmarks, application material)

points.label: Lower materiality for particular items
points.description: Where misstatements of smaller amounts in particular classes of transactions, balances or disclosures could influence users (for example related party transactions or managerial remuneration), the auditor sets a lower materiality level for them.
points.basis: SA 320, materiality level for particular classes of transactions, account balances or disclosures

points.label: Performance materiality
points.description: An amount set below materiality to reduce to an appropriately low level the chance that uncorrected and undetected misstatements together exceed materiality; it guides the nature, timing and extent of further audit procedures.

points.label: Revision and documentation
points.description: Materiality is revised if the auditor learns of information during the audit that would have led to a different amount at the start (for example actual results differ a lot from forecasts); if it is lowered, performance materiality and further procedures are reconsidered. The amounts and factors used are documented.
points.basis: SA 320, revision as the audit progresses, and documentation
